verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order and a clean left edge, but the bottle is a tiny figure stuck at the top of the circle, so the product barely registers. Below the CTA there are about 150px of dead space, which makes the layout top-heavy and looks like a stacked copy of the original. B uses the tall format better, with a large headline and a dominant bottle, but it moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the body copy, where it is cramped and out of reading order. B also centers the CTA and bottle under left-aligned text, so the alignment is mixed, and the headline sits awkwardly across the circle's edge.
